display.longDescription: Hermes 是 Hermes Agent 的本体组件。Kite 固定官方版本和提交，只安装核心运行依赖与 ACP，不自动安装桌面、浏览器、TTS、ffmpeg 或其他可选能力；代码、venv 和数据目录都固定在这张资源自己的软件区，并暴露 /workspace/.kf/bin/hermes。Nous Portal 官方账号可从 Agent 模型库发起登录或退出，凭据仍由 Hermes 自己管理。

agents.name: Hermes
agents.description: Hermes 原生 ACP 会话

steps.cmd:
mkdir -p "$install_root/home" "$install_root/user-home" "/workspace/.kf/cache/resources/kite.hermes.core/uv"
cat > "$install_root/kite-install-core-acp.sh" <<'KITE_HERMES_INSTALL'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
: "${KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT:?KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT is required}"
repo_dir="$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/hermes-agent"
command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=hermes-python reason=uv-missing'; exit 127; }
agent_python=""
for candidate in /usr/bin/python3.13 /usr/bin/python3.12 /usr/bin/python3.11; do
  if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then
    agent_python="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
[ -n "$agent_python" ] || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=hermes-python reason=compatible-system-python-missing'; exit 127; }
agent_python_version="$("$agent_python" -c 'import sys; print(f"{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}")')"
case "$agent_python_version" in
  3.11|3.12|3.13) ;;
  *) echo "KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=hermes-python reason=unsupported-version version=$agent_python_version"; exit 65 ;;
esac
echo "KITE_RESOURCE_STEP prepare hermes-python-$agent_python_version source=system"
echo "KITE_RESOURCE_STEP install hermes-core-acp python=$agent_python"
install_status=1
for pypi_route in $KITE_RESOURCE_PYPI_ROUTES; do
  source_id="${pypi_route%%|*}"
  pypi_index="${pypi_route#*|}"
  attempt_root="$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/.kite-source-attempt/pypi/$source_id"
  attempt_cache="$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/.kite-source-cache/pypi/$source_id"
  attempt_log="$attempt_root/uv-sync.log"
  rm -rf "$attempt_root" "$repo_dir/venv"
  mkdir -p "$attempt_root" "$attempt_cache"
  echo "KITE_RESOURCE_ROUTE stage=acquire step=hermes-python-packages source=$source_id index=$pypi_index"
  set +e
  timeout 900 env UV_DEFAULT_INDEX="$pypi_index" UV_CACHE_DIR="$attempt_cache" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$repo_dir/venv" UV_PYTHON="$agent_python" uv sync --project "$repo_dir" --locked --no-default-groups --extra acp >"$attempt_log" 2>&1
  install_status=$?
  set -e
  cat "$attempt_log"
  if [ "$install_status" -eq 0 ]; then
    rm -rf "$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/.kite-source-attempt"
    echo "KITE_RESOURCE_STEP acquire-complete hermes-python-packages source=$source_id"
    break
  fi
  rm -rf "$repo_dir/venv"
  if ! kite_resource_is_source_failure "$install_status" "$attempt_log"; then
    echo "KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-python-packages source=$source_id exit=$install_status reason=non-network"
    exit "$install_status"
  fi
  echo "KITE_RESOURCE_RETRY stage=acquire step=hermes-python-packages source=$source_id exit=$install_status reason=source-unavailable"
  rm -rf "$attempt_root"
done
[ "$install_status" -eq 0 ] || { rm -rf "$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/.kite-source-attempt"; echo "KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=acquire step=hermes-python-packages exit=$install_status"; exit "$install_status"; }
[ -x "$repo_dir/venv/bin/hermes" ] || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-core-acp reason=entrypoint-missing'; exit 127; }
printf '%s\n' 'core+acp' > "$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/install-profile"
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP install-complete hermes-core-acp'
KITE_HERMES_INSTALL
chmod +x "$install_root/kite-install-core-acp.sh"

agent_python="$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python"
session_file="$install_root/hermes-agent/acp_adapter/session.py"
test -x "$agent_python" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-provider-identity reason=python-missing'; exit 127; }
test -f "$session_file" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-provider-identity reason=session-source-missing'; exit 66; }
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch hermes-acp-provider-identity'
"$agent_python" - "$session_file" <<'KITE_HERMES_PROVIDER_PATCH'
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

target = Path(sys.argv[1])
source = target.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
import_old = 'from hermes_cli.runtime_provider import resolve_runtime_provider'
import_new = 'from hermes_cli.runtime_provider import canonical_custom_identity, resolve_runtime_provider'
if import_new not in source:
    if import_old not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes runtime provider import contract changed')
    source = source.replace(import_old, import_new, 1)

persist_anchor = '        api_mode = getattr(state.agent, "api_mode", None)\n'
persist_marker = '            provider = canonical_custom_identity(\n'
if persist_marker not in source:
    if persist_anchor not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP persistence contract changed')
    persist_patch = persist_anchor + (
        '        if isinstance(provider, str) and provider.strip().lower() == "custom":\n'
        '            provider = canonical_custom_identity(\n'
        '                base_url=base_url if isinstance(base_url, str) else None,\n'
        '                model=model_str,\n'
        '            ) or provider\n'
    )
    source = source.replace(persist_anchor, persist_patch, 1)

persist_import = '            from hermes_cli.runtime_provider import canonical_custom_identity\n'
if persist_import not in source:
    if persist_marker not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP persistence provider contract changed')
    source = source.replace(persist_marker, persist_import + persist_marker, 1)

restore_old = '            runtime = resolve_runtime_provider(requested=requested_provider or config_provider)'
restore_marker = '            runtime_provider = requested_provider or config_provider'
if restore_marker not in source:
    if restore_old not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP restore contract changed')
    restore_patch = (
        '            runtime_provider = requested_provider or config_provider\n'
        '            if str(runtime_provider or "").strip().lower() == "custom":\n'
        '                runtime_provider = canonical_custom_identity(\n'
        '                    base_url=base_url,\n'
        '                    config_provider=config_provider,\n'
        '                    model=model or default_model,\n'
        '                ) or runtime_provider\n'
        '            runtime = resolve_runtime_provider(requested=runtime_provider)'
    )
    source = source.replace(restore_old, restore_patch, 1)

compile(source, str(target), 'exec')
temporary = target.with_name(target.name + '.kite-pending')
temporary.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
os.replace(temporary, target)
KITE_HERMES_PROVIDER_PATCH
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch-complete hermes-acp-provider-identity'

agent_python="$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python"
server_file="$install_root/hermes-agent/acp_adapter/server.py"
test -x "$agent_python" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-model-selection reason=python-missing'; exit 127; }
test -f "$server_file" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-model-selection reason=server-source-missing'; exit 66; }
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch hermes-acp-model-selection'
"$agent_python" - "$server_file" <<'KITE_HERMES_MODEL_PATCH'
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

target = Path(sys.argv[1])
source = target.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
anchor = '        target_provider = current_provider\n        new_model = raw_model.strip()\n\n'
marker = '        # Kite compatibility: resolve named custom ACP choices before generic parsing.\n'
if marker not in source:
    if anchor not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP model selection contract changed')
    patch = anchor + (
        marker
        + '        try:\n'
        + '            from hermes_cli.models import _configured_custom_provider_ids\n\n'
        + '            configured = (\n'
        + '                str(provider_id).strip().lower()\n'
        + '                for provider_id in _configured_custom_provider_ids()\n'
        + '                if str(provider_id).strip().lower().startswith("custom:")\n'
        + '            )\n'
        + '            lowered = new_model.lower()\n'
        + '            for candidate in sorted(configured, key=len, reverse=True):\n'
        + '                prefix = candidate + ":"\n'
        + '                if lowered.startswith(prefix):\n'
        + '                    return candidate, new_model[len(prefix):]\n'
        + '        except Exception:\n'
        + '            logger.debug("Named custom provider detection failed", exc_info=True)\n\n'
    )
    source = source.replace(anchor, patch, 1)

compile(source, str(target), 'exec')
temporary = target.with_name(target.name + '.kite-pending')
temporary.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
os.replace(temporary, target)
KITE_HERMES_MODEL_PATCH
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch-complete hermes-acp-model-selection'

agent_python="$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python"
server_file="$install_root/hermes-agent/acp_adapter/server.py"
test -x "$agent_python" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-bare-provider-selection reason=python-missing'; exit 127; }
test -f "$server_file" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-bare-provider-selection reason=server-source-missing'; exit 66; }
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch hermes-acp-bare-provider-selection'
"$agent_python" - "$server_file" <<'KITE_HERMES_BARE_PROVIDER_PATCH'
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

target = Path(sys.argv[1])
source = target.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old = (
    '            for candidate in sorted(configured, key=len, reverse=True):\n'
    '                prefix = candidate + ":"\n'
    '                if lowered.startswith(prefix):\n'
    '                    return candidate, new_model[len(prefix):]\n'
)
new = (
    '            for candidate in sorted(configured, key=len, reverse=True):\n'
    '                prefixes = (candidate + ":", candidate.removeprefix("custom:") + ":")\n'
    '                for prefix in prefixes:\n'
    '                    if lowered.startswith(prefix):\n'
    '                        return candidate, new_model[len(prefix):]\n'
)
marker = '                prefixes = (candidate + ":", candidate.removeprefix("custom:") + ":")\n'
if marker not in source:
    if old not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP named-provider compatibility contract changed')
    source = source.replace(old, new, 1)

compile(source, str(target), 'exec')
temporary = target.with_name(target.name + '.kite-pending')
temporary.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
os.replace(temporary, target)
KITE_HERMES_BARE_PROVIDER_PATCH
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch-complete hermes-acp-bare-provider-selection'

agent_python="$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python"
if [ ! -x "$agent_python" ]; then echo 'Hermes Agent Python missing'; exit 127; fi
if [ ! -x "$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/hermes" ]; then echo 'Hermes Agent entrypoint missing'; exit 127; fi
mkdir -p "$install_root/bin"
cat > "$install_root/bin/hermes" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
export HERMES_HOME="$install_root/home"
export PATH="/workspace/.kf/bin:/root/.local/bin:\$PATH"
unset PYTHONPATH
unset PYTHONHOME
if [ "\${1:-}" = "acp" ]; then
  export HERMES_DISABLE_LAZY_INSTALLS=1
fi
exec "$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/hermes" "\$@"
EOF
chmod +x "$install_root/bin/hermes"
printf '%s\n' 'v2026.8.27.4' > "$install_root/.kite-version"

verify.cmd: grep -q 'Kite compatibility: resolve named custom ACP choices' "$install_root/hermes-agent/acp_adapter/server.py" && grep -q '_configured_custom_provider_ids' "$install_root/hermes-agent/acp_adapter/server.py"
